Philips.description: Philips is a Dutch multinational founded in Eindhoven in 1891. Originally a light bulb manufacturer, the company became one of the world's largest electronics corporations, known for iconic consumer products ranging from radios and shavers to medical equipment.

Braun.description: Braun GmbH is a German consumer products company founded in 1921. Under the creative direction of Dieter Rams from the 1960s onward, Braun became synonymous with the principle of 'less but better' — producing some of the most influential industrial design of the 20th century.
